title: Biography Flash: Warren Buffett Steps Back as Berkshire Bets Big on Housing
summary: As of October 10, the biggest Warren Buffett story is not a new investment personally announced by the 96 year old investor, but the formal end of his Berkshire Hathaway era. Bloomberg and CNBC report that Buffett stepped down as chief executive at the end of 2025 and became chairman emeritus in September, with Greg Abel running the company and Buffett’s son Howard becoming chairman. Buffett remains on Berkshire’s board, but the succession that investors watched for decades is now history.
